texts: The Council hears apprentice progress reports.
The Council hears salt-bloom harvest reports.
When a Keeper retires, the Council re-staffs that Keeper's station.
When a Keeper dies, the Council re-staffs that Keeper's station.
The Council reads letters from other villages aloud.

review.notes: "The Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (common noun, no Name atom, singular collective so no GroupOf), and the habitual present correctly gets no status atom; the bare-plural object is non-specific/kind-level, so the bare kind filler feather_ration rather than a group witness is right.

fields.sentence: The Council hears apprentice progress reports.

review.notes: "The Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (witness + kind atom, no Name) and the singular-collective no-distribution rule, and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom. "hear" is on the instruction set's stative perception list, so Experiencer/Stimulus is the licensed routing even in this institutional sense.

fields.sentence: The Council hears salt-bloom harvest reports.

review.notes: Stative perception "hear" correctly takes Experiencer/Stimulus, the definite singular subject correctly blocks the bare-kind relational-generic route, and the unmarked habitual reading licenses the bare kind filler for the bare-plural object. The compound genus (Inheritance salt_bloom_harvest_report report) is emitted with the noun modifier correctly left unexposed.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper retires, the Council re-staffs that Keeper's station.
parse: (: e2_rule (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $x retire) (Agent $x $k)) (And (Member (sk_restaff $x) re_staff) (Agent (sk_restaff $x) sk_council_1) (Patient (sk_restaff $x) (sk_station $k)) (Member (sk_station $k) station) (Possession (sk_station $k) $k) (During (sk_restaff $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare "when P, Q" with an indefinite participant correctly routes to the whenever machinery (plain-variable premises, per-occurrence Skolem consequent, During link, STV 1.0 0.9), and "that Keeper's station" is correctly a $k-dependent Skolem entity with opaque Possession. Two cosmetic/borderline points only: the Skolem stem sk_restaff does not exactly mirror the verb lemma re_staff, and Patient (vs the unclear-case default Theme) for the re-staffed station is a judgment call.

fields.sentence: When a Keeper dies, the Council re-staffs that Keeper's station.
parse: (: lore236_rule (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $e die) (Patient $e $k)) (And (Member (sk_staff $k) staff) (Agent (sk_staff $k) sk_council_1) (Member (sk_station $k) station) (Possession (sk_station $k) $k) (Patient (sk_staff $k) (sk_station $k)) (Again (sk_staff $k)) (During (sk_staff $k) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "re-staffs" is rendered as the bare verb class `staff` plus an `(Again ...)` tag, but the instruction set licenses `Again` only for the surface particle "again" and permits inflectional lemmatization only, so stripping the derivational prefix and re-expressing it as an aspectual tag is a normalization the prompt reserves for downstream.

The whenever machinery Skolemizes the response per occurrence on the trigger-event variable, but this rule builds `(sk_staff $k)` and `(sk_station $k)` on the keeper while `During` links to `$e`, so the response is a function of the keeper rather than of the death occurrence it is tied to.

q2_gaps: a verb carrying a restitutive/derivational prefix ("re-staff", "re-open"): the instruction set covers the particle "again" and bars derivation in lemmatization, but never says how such a verb's class symbol should be formed
review.notes: The bare "when a Keeper dies" with generic participants correctly takes the whenever-rule route with the During link, `die` gives its subject `Patient`, "that Keeper's station" takes the opaque `Possession`, and "the Council" / "a Keeper" are handled as capitalized common nouns with no `Name` atom. Rule TV 1.0/0.9 and the absence of a `QuantifierPhrase` companion both match doctrine.

issues.reason: Names and casing licenses inflectional lemmatization only and bars derivation, so a prefixed verb keeps its own form (re_staff), and Again is defined for the free aspectual particle -- rewriting re-staffs as staff plus (Again ...) is exactly the paraphrase-equivalence the prompt reserves for downstream normalization (as with go_out vs fail).

The whenever machinery Skolemizes the response per occurrence on the trigger-event variable ((sk_bark $x) in the prompt's own example), and the multi-quantifier rule requires a dependent existential to be a Skolem function of every universal that scopes over it, so the terms must be indexed on $e (or on $k and $e), not on $k alone while During links to $e.

gaps_confirmed: a restitutive / derivational prefix verb (re-staff, re-open): the lemmatization rule does fix the class symbol (re_staff), but nothing says how the restitutive meaning is recorded
new_gaps: Again is licensed only for the free particle, so once the surface lemma re_staff is kept the 'a prior same-type event happened' presupposition has no licensed carrier at all -- a prefix-borne aspectual tag is unlegislated, and dropping it loses stated content
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form keeps the surface lemma -- (Member (sk_staff ...) re_staff) with no Again tag, the restitutive presupposition going unrecorded as the gap filed above; and the consequent's Skolem terms must be indexed on the trigger occurrence, (sk_staff $e) / (sk_station $e) or (sk_staff $k $e), so the response is one per death rather than one per Keeper.
adjudication.notes: Everything else is doctrinal: bare 'when' with generic participants takes the whenever rule with the During link, die gives its subject Patient, 'that Keeper's station' takes the opaque Possession, 'the Council' is a capitalized common noun with no Name, and the rule's 1.0/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion is correct.

fields.sentence: The Council reads letters from other villages aloud.

q1_issues.issue: The descriptive modifier "other" is predicated of the group symbol as (Member sk_village_1 other), the form Categorical statements explicitly bars — a members' property must go through the distributive rule and never ride the group symbol, which a bare (Member <group> <prop>) reserves for a property of the collection itself.

"letters" is the non-specific object of a habitual (non-episodic) present clause, which the bare-plural rule assigns the bare kind filler ("pays tax", "grows wheat"), not an existential group witness.
Likewise sk_village_1: the group witness posits one specific set of villages that a habitual clause does not pick out.

q2_gaps: contrastive / anaphoric "other" as a nominal modifier ("other villages") — the instruction set gives RestOf for "the rest of" / "the remaining" but no carrier or treatment for "other"
a restrictive PP on a non-specific bare-plural object ("letters from other villages") — the bare-kind-filler route leaves no entity symbol for the entity-attached From to attach to
review.notes: The singular collective subject correctly takes a plain event with no distribution rule and no status atom (habitual), read is the listed Theme verb, From is the licensed entity-attached origin head, and aloud is a manner-proper adverb; the defects are confined to the plural handling of "other villages".

issues.reason: *Categorical statements* bars a members' property from riding the group symbol — "a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself" — and "other" is a member-level contrast (each village is other than the Council's own), so (Member sk_village_1 other) asserts precisely the group-as-object reading that rule names as wrong.

The bare-kind-filler routing the issue cites leaves the restrictive "from other villages" with no symbol for the entity-attached From to attach to, and *Core patterns* forbids silently dropping a stated restriction, so minting the group witness to carry it is licensed improvisation inside the very gap the reviewer's own q2 records — every atom well-typed and true of the sentence.

Same licence: "other villages" is a modified NP whose restriction needs a referent, and the bare kind symbol village could carry neither the modifier nor the From link; the group witness is not the fault — its Member-placed modifier is, which is issue 0.

gaps_confirmed: contrastive / anaphoric "other" as a nominal modifier has no licensed carrier (RestOf covers only "the rest of" / "the remaining")
a restrictive PP on a non-specific bare-plural object of a habitual clause: the bare-kind-filler route leaves no entity symbol for the entity-attached From
adjudication.defect_summary: For the confirmed issue the compliant form is the per-member distribution rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_village_1) (Member $x other)) beside the group witness rather than (Member sk_village_1 other); and if "other" resists a distributive property reading at all — it marks anaphoric contrast, not a property any village holds in isolation — the instruction set licenses no carrier and the restriction must be recorded as a gap rather than asserted in either placement, which is the first gap above.
adjudication.notes: The singular collective subject with no distribution rule and no status atom, the Theme role for read, the entity-attached From, and Manner aloud are all correct; the whole fault is the placement of "other", not the decision to individuate the two plurals.
